name: tw.com.ecpay.paymentgatewaykit.framework.payment.bind.view.CreditCardListActivity
description: When a user opens saved-card management in the ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK, this screen loads the saved card list and offers actions to add or edit a card.
disableEffect: Saved-card management may not open, so users may be unable to review or update cards used for payment.
